description:
Build the policy management layer for vrooli-events:

**Policy CRUD API** — REST endpoints for managing policy_rules table (schema: id INTEGER PK, kind TEXT CHECK(access|rate_limit|circuit_breaker), source_pattern TEXT, target_pattern TEXT, action_pattern TEXT, priority INTEGER, rule_data TEXT as JSON, enabled INTEGER, created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT). Pattern columns use glob syntax. Priority column stores computed specificity score for access control rules.

**Receiver-side enforcement middleware** — Standard Go http.Handler chain pattern with three middleware layers:
1. **Access control**: Most-specific-wins evaluation with segment-count scoring (exact match=3pts, prefix glob=2pts, wildcard=1pt, summed across source+target+action patterns, max 9, ties broken by earliest creation time).
2. **Token bucket rate limiting**: Per-rule state tracking (tokens_remaining + last_refill_time). Each RateLimit rule specifies capacity (max burst) and refill_rate (tokens/sec). Industry-standard algorithm avoiding fixed-window boundary spike problem.
3. **Circuit breaking**: 3-state machine (closed/open/half-open) keyed by {source_scenario}.{target_scenario}.{action}. Configurable threshold and cooldown per route. Auto-reset when cooldown elapses.

**Policy push** — On any rule change, push full policy ruleset snapshot to all connected SSE clients for atomic cache replacement (no partial state, no version tracking). Bandwidth-acceptable at current scale (dozens of rules).
name: vrooli-events-policy-api-and-middleware
title: Policy CRUD API And Receiver-Side Enforcement Middleware
